LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 1.3.1 WORD CLASSES: NOUNS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Grammar In Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar In Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to identify items by name? 2. Why is knowledge of the use of capital letters useful?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar In Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to Learn: Learner displays the skill of working collaboratively while engaging in language games such as scrabble, puzzles,

code words, and guessing games on nouns in groups.

● Digital literacy: Learner displays the skill of digital citizenship as they watch a signed demonstration or signed video clip with

examples of nouns.

Values:
● Unity: Leaner displays cooperation as learners work in pairs to complete substitution tables with the different types of nouns.

● Patriotism: Leaner displays loyalty as they identify with their locality when talking about people, places, and institutions in their

community.

Link to other subjects:

The learner uses the concept of nouns in learning other languages such as Kiswahili.
